Billboard 
#| cache: true
```{r}
billboard <- readr::read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```
```{r}
ggplot2::ggplot(billboard, ggplot2::aes(x = wk1)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(subtitle = paste("Values used:", sum(!is.na(billboard$wk1))))
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      c(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76),
      list(
        missing = \(x) sum(is.na(x)),
        present = \(x) sum(!is.na(x))
      )
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = c("week", "status"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = count)
```
```{r}
billboard |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer)
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = week,
      y = rank,
      group = interaction(artist, track)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_reverse() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Week", y = "Billboard rank")
```
```{r}
top10 <- tibble::tibble(
  rank = 1:10,
  song = c(
    "Patient Zero", "Choosin' Texas", "Boston", "Been By Now",
    "Dracula", "Nicole Kidman", "Hate That I Made You Love Me",
    "Stupid Song", "BbY WOW", "Babydoll"
  ),
  artist = c(
    "Taylor Swift", "Ella Langley", "Stella Lefty", "Morgan Wallen",
    "Tame Impala & JENNIE", "ADELA", "Ariana Grande",
    "Olivia Rodrigo", "Karol G with Judeline & rusowsky", "Dominic Fike"
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste(song, "-", artist))

ggplot2::ggplot(top10, ggplot2::aes(x = rank, y = stats::reorder(label, -rank))) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Billboard Hot 100 — October 24, 2026",
    x = "Rank (1 = highest)",
    y = NULL
  )
```
